universities.research_notes: IFC: official fsl.fsu.edu governing-councils page states IFC 'governs 15 men's fraternities' while the official FSU IFC website (fsuifc.com/chapter-profiles) lists 20 chapter names — count discrepancy unresolved; all 20 names as shown on FSU IFC's own site are recorded, status unknown for all. NPHC: fsl.fsu.edu states NPHC 'consists of 9' organizations, but the official FSU NPHC site (fsunphc.com) lists only 7 member chapters — discrepancy noted; the 7 confirmed chapters are recorded. MGC: fsl.fsu.edu states MGC 'governs 8' organizations, FSU MGC's own About page text says 'ten culturally based organizations', but its Chapters page (fsumgc.com/chapters) lists only 7 names — three conflicting counts across FSU/MGC-affiliated official sources; the 7 verbatim chapter names from fsumgc.com/chapters are recorded here. FSU also has a United Greek Council (UGC) with 2 fraternities per fsl.fsu.edu, but no chapter names could be found on any official source, so UGC chapters are omitted. Panhellenic (17 sororities per fsl.fsu.edu) was not researched in detail (not required).

universities.research_notes: IFC roster (34 chapters) sourced from the official Alabama IFC website (universityofalabamaifc.com/fraternities); the university's own ofsl.sl.ua.edu IFC page could not be fetched directly due to a persistent TLS certificate error on our fetch tool, but its search-indexed text corroborates the same count ('34 IFC fraternities'), giving confidence in the IFC list. NPHC chapter names could NOT be directly fetched from the official ofsl.sl.ua.edu NPHC page due to the same recurring certificate error (tried https and http, and the domain's cert issue affected every ofsl.sl.ua.edu URL attempted); the 8 chapters listed here are reconstructed from Google-indexed snippets of that same official page and are ALL flagged needs_review pending direct human verification of the primary source. UA does not appear to have a separate MGC; instead it has a United Greek Council (UGC) with roughly 10 culturally-based/special-interest organizations (mostly co-ed/professional fraternities like Alpha Kappa Psi and Kappa Kappa Psi, plus one men's music fraternity, Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia) — these were not included since the task's scope was IFC/NPHC/MGC and UGC's roster is a different governance model than a typical social/cultural Greek council.
